name: ReadStatusBar
label: Read Status Bar
description: Reads the status bar message from the active SAP session.

fields.name: DelayBefore
fields.label: Delay Before
fields.description: Time to wait before executing the activity, in seconds. Default is 0.2 seconds.

fields.name: DelayAfter
fields.label: Delay After
fields.description: Time to wait after executing the activity, in seconds. Default is 0.3 seconds.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.label: Timeout
fields.description: Maximum time to wait for the operation to complete, in seconds. Default is 30 seconds.

fields.name: MessageType
fields.label: Message Type
fields.description: The type of message shown in the status bar (e.g., 'I' for Info, 'E' for Error, 'S' for Success).

fields.name: MessageText
fields.label: Message Text
fields.description: The main message text displayed in the SAP status bar (e.g., 'Transaction completed successfully').

fields.name: MessageID
fields.label: Message ID
fields.description: The internal message ID (e.g., 'M001'), used in SAP for message classification.

fields.name: MessageNumber
fields.label: Message Number
fields.description: The message number (e.g., '001'), part of the SAP message ID system.
